title: Late-Arrival Credit on Returnless Damage Credits for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
A returnless damage credit on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders carries a late-arrival credit that counts calendar days from the order's promised date to its completed date, both read from the order record.

**Schedule.**

- 3 or more days after the promised date: $1.50.
- At least 1 but fewer than 3 days after the promised date: $0.75.
- Completed on or before the promised date: nothing.

| Completed date compared with promised date | Late-arrival credit |
|---|---|
| Before the promised date | Nothing |
| On the promised date | Nothing |
| 1 day after | $0.75 |
| 2 days after | $0.75 |
| 3 days after | $1.50 |
| 6 days after | $1.50 |

**Example (hypothetical).** An order promised for 12 August and delivered on 15 August is 3 days late; its returnless damage credit carries $1.50 for late arrival.
